svg.title: Figure 3-10. FMEDA SG-001 metrics per goal (estimate)
svg.desc: FMEDA FMD rev 0.7 (BL-002, draft) for SG-01, SG-02, SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-06, with 7 of 8 failure rates generic estimates. Metrics per goal: SG-01 C, SG-02 C, SG-03 C, SG-04 B, SG-06 C: SPFM 96.84 %, LFM 88.94 %, λSPF+λRF 8.07 FIT (ASIL C missed, ASIL B met on the estimate, not verified); SG-05 B: SPFM 90.38 %, LFM 95.30 %, λSPF+λRF 24.6 FIT (ASIL B met on the estimate, not verified). Below: failure-rate split per component and failure mode, and the safety mechanisms with the failure modes they are credited on.
svg.text: Figure 3-10 · FMEDA SG-001 — metrics per goal: SG-01, SG-02, SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-06
FMD rev 0.7 · BL-002 · draft · FMEDA — SG-001 lateral (panda safety path), generic failure rates
ESTIMATE · DRAFT — 7 of 8 failure rates are generic estimates and 0 are converted to the mission profile. The metrics below are not verified and are not evidence that a target is met.
HARDWARE ARCHITECTURAL METRICS PER SAFETY GOAL (WP-H-04 §4; rating-tables §6.3)
SG-01 C · SG-02 C · SG-03 C · SG-04 B
ASIL B met on this estimate
ASIL B met on this estimate

Dashed ticks: ASIL targets of the goals in the row (B shown alongside C for SG-01, DQ-063). λSPF + λRF is the single-point and residual part of PMHF only; the dual-point term is not computed (rating-tables §6.3).
FAILURE-RATE SPLIT PER COMPONENT (FIT) — CLASSIFICATION PER rating-tables §6.1
STM32H725 CPU core, bus matrix, interrupt controller and
Embedded flash 1 MB (code and limit constants)
SRAM regions holding safety state, limits copy and CAN
queues (about 64 KB of 564 KB; soft errors dominate)
Clock: 25 MHz HSE crystal and PLL
MCU supply: board regulator and STM32H7 internal
Intercept switch: 2 × DG419LE CMOS analog SPDT (harness
SBU1 pull-down: 2 × 120 Ω thick-film resistor in series
Totals: λ 255.4 FIT · λSPF 4.5 · λRF 3.57 · λMPF,latent 27.4 FIT. Chip = failure mode with its class, FIT and the credited safety mechanism with its DC.
SAFETY MECHANISMS (DC CLAIMED PER FAILURE MODE)
Flash ECC (single-error correction in silicon; corrected reads are transparent)
SRAM ECC (single-error correction in silicon); double errors flagged but not handled at BL-002 [TSR-503]
Bootstub signature check of the application image at every power-up
8-bit XOR over the TX packet checked before loading into the FDCAN FIFO [TSR-517]
Clock security system on HSE loss: NMI and reset [TSR-504]
Relay malfunction detection: a stock camera control message seen on the car side blocks all TX (1 s grace after a mode…
CAN protocol CRC and per-message RX timeout (5 periods) on vehicle messages [TSR-401]
